mapper.select: SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, user_tag, profile_image, provider, provider_id, quiet_time_start, quiet_time_end, created_at, updated_at FROM public.users WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id, email, password, nickname, user_tag, profile_image, provider, provider_id, quiet_time_start, quiet_time_end, created_at, updated_at FROM public.users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.users ( email, password, nickname, user_tag, profile_image, provider, provider_id, quiet_time_start, quiet_time_end, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{userTag}, #{profileImage}, #{provider}, #{providerId}, #{quietTimeStart}, #{quietTimeEnd}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE public.users SET nickname = #{nickname}, profile_image = #{profileImage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE public.users SET quiet_time_start = #{quietTimeStart}, quiet_time_end = #{quietTimeEnd}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE public.recipe SET user_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
